description: Conferences pulled from the connected meeting providers, newest first. Optional: lead_id, with_transcript (only those whose transcript is stored), since, limit (default 20). transcript_status says why one is missing: none = the provider has no transcript, available = there is one but it has not been fetched, error = fetching failed (transcript_error says why).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

since.description: Only entries from this point in time on (ISO 8601)

with_transcript.description: Only conferences whose transcript is stored

name: list_meeting_recordings
